answer.summary: API Types Check failed because the committed generated TypeScript types are stale. The diff shows new API output types (LocalObjectOutput, XtmConnectionOutput, and new edge/node/link fields) that the PR's Java DTO changes produce but the front-end types don't include. The log itself says to regenerate types before committing. Re-running will fail the same way; regenerate with yarn generate-types-from-api and commit the result.
